facts.fact: 男人站在门口石阶上打量开门的年轻女子。
facts.anchor: She opened the door and he stood on the top stone step and looked her up and down.

facts.fact: 他说自己有她可能感兴趣的消息。
facts.anchor: ‘I have some information that might interest you.’

facts.fact: 叙述点明他只讲真相的一个版本。
facts.anchor: He only ever told anyone a version of the truth.

facts.fact: 她提议去街角咖啡馆谈。
facts.anchor: ‘Can we talk somewhere else?’ she asked. ‘Like, maybe in the café down the road?’

facts.fact: 他看表推说时间不够，拒绝换地方。
facts.anchor: ‘Thing is, I don’t have much time. I’ve got to be somewhere soon.’

facts.fact: 他再次微笑，双手一直插在大衣口袋里。
facts.anchor: He smiled again, keeping his hands firmly inside his coat pockets.
